instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to install Orchis theme from gnome-look.org but the site was unreachable (ERR_TIMED_OUT). Spent ~25 turns waiting and retrying in Chrome. Then opened terminal and tried curl to download from gnome-look.org (failed) and GitHub (0-byte file). Never installed or applied any theme.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, type URLs, navigate address bar, open terminal, run bash commands (curl, ls, ping, gsettings), switch between Chrome and terminal windows
metadata.failure_analysis: gnome-look.org was not accessible from the VM (network timeout). The model correctly identified the need to use terminal as fallback but the GitHub download also produced a 0-byte file.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed the complex theme installation task into a simpler Chrome settings task. Changing font size requires navigating Chrome settings, which the model demonstrated capability for (URL bar navigation). No external site access needed.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome settings and changing the default font size to Large (20px). Evaluator uses chrome_font_size getter to read Chrome preferences and check_font_size metric to verify the value is 20.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'chrome_font_size' correctly reads Chrome Preferences JSON and returns the 'webkit.webprefs' dict containing 'default_font_size'.
Metric 'check_font_size' correctly extracts 'default_font_size' from the getter result and compares it to the expected value using exact match.
Expected value 20 is correct: Chrome's 'Large' font size preset corresponds to 20px (Very Small=9, Small=12, Medium=16, Large=20, Very Large=24).
The instruction has a single requirement (set font size to Large) and the evaluator fully covers it.
No postconfig needed — font size is persisted in the Chrome Preferences file on disk, no UI state dependency.
